entries.zh: 胀破；因肿胀而爆裂（如疮疖胀破）
entries.en: to burst from swelling; to break open from bloating

entries.zh: 胀迫；胀满壅塞、腹胁窘迫
entries.en: distended and oppressed; bloated pressure from swelling

entries.zh: 胀开；因肿胀而绽裂
entries.en: to gape or split open from swelling

entries.zh: 以药攻破（用药使疮肿破溃）；首字‘珀’存疑（疑作‘砒’，砒霜蚀疮之意）
entries.en: to burst (an abscess or boil) by means of medicine
entries.notes: 汉字栏[疑:珀/砒]未能定夺；西语义为以药物使肿疡破溃，随[疑]标取中置信。

entries.zh: 运：翻滚、打滚（此处指与猪同滚之态）
entries.en: to roll about, wallow (as pigs do)

entries.zh: 运烂土：在烂泥地里打滚（如猪滚泥）
entries.en: to wallow in the mire, roll about in the mud

entries.zh: 翻来覆去：在床上辗转反侧、翻覆不定
entries.en: to toss and turn in bed, roll over and over
entries.notes: 惯用语‘翻来覆去’其义自明，但‘來’字带[疑:來/耒]，按[疑]标取中置信。

entries.zh: 卤：粗鲁、鲁莽（卤莽之单字）
entries.en: crude, boorish, unruly
entries.notes: 西语栏内嵌‘chám jǐn’音写未能与释义对应，存疑；依‘卤’字与 reboltoso（粗野无礼）相合定夺。

entries.zh: 唅（疑作‘咍’）：疑指聒噪絮聒、杂语不休；未能定夺
entries.en: uncertain: apparently noisy prattling or unruly chatter
entries.notes: 汉字[疑:唅/咍]，且闽语栏连写音节多出、与汉字不一一对应，释义仅存疑参考。

entries.zh: 卤莽：鲁莽、粗率冒失
entries.en: rash, reckless, boorish

entries.zh: 无藉：无赖、无藉之徒（游手好闲之恶棍）
entries.en: rascal, good-for-nothing vagabond (bellaco)

entries.zh: 奸盗诈伪：奸邪、偷盗、欺诈、虚伪（恶徒行径）
entries.en: treacherous, thieving, deceitful and false — the conduct of a rogue

entries.zh: 巷究家[疑:‘究’或作‘宄’]：疑指街巷奸宄、恶人之家；未能定夺
entries.en: uncertain: apparently a household or den of street villains
entries.notes: ‘究’带[疑:究/宄]，闽语栏音写与汉字不对应，词义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 鬼贼：鬼祟狡诈之贼、骗子
entries.en: sneaky, devilish thief; impostor, trickster (embustero)

entries.zh: 生事害人：惹是生非、造谣生事以害人
entries.en: to stir up trouble and harm others; slanderous troublemaker (murmurador)

entries.zh: 僥漓：疑指狡黠饶舌、搬弄是非（词形非标准复合词）
entries.en: uncertain: apparently glib, divisive prattle; a sly, meddlesome talker
entries.notes: ‘僥漓’非标准汉语复合词，与 murmurador（好议人非）之义相配仅属推测，取中置信。

entries.zh: 谄臣：谄媚逢迎之臣、佞臣
entries.en: fawning courtier, sycophantic minister
entries.notes: 西语栏仅存波浪号（续前词头），释义依汉字与闽语两栏互证定夺。

entries.zh: 捕杂[疑为‘插杂’之误书]：混杂、掺和；插手搅和（多事）
entries.en: to meddle and mix oneself in other people's affairs; jumbled together
entries.notes: 首字‘捕’与闽语栏音写不合，疑为‘插’之误书；依‘杂’字与西语 reboltoso（多事好闹）取中置信。

entries.zh: 逞强：逞凶恃强、好斗逞能
entries.en: to act tough and flaunt one's strength; fond of fighting

entries.zh: 肆毒：肆意荼毒、横行施暴（好斗行凶）
entries.en: to wreak havoc, act with wanton cruelty; belligerent
